deviations: No adaptive behavior ever fired: doctrines_played=[] and switches=[] in all 8 games; the bot is a pure static turtler with no response to being behind (s300003-r2 stalled at pop 11, 129 units, scalar 2009, rank 3) or ahead.

Unit production is a rigid linear treadmill (~+11 units per 10 turns in nearly every game) regardless of game state; by t=160 there are 129-177 units for only 2 cities, well past any plausible defensive need, and gold repeatedly bottoms out at 45-77 (e.g., s947381-r0 at t=120, s300003-r2 at t=90), suggesting maintenance drag from the oversized army.

After the 8-tech list completes (~t=20), research output has no replacement use for the remaining 140 turns; pop plateaus by t=60-70 in most games, so the late-game economy adds nothing beyond unit spam.

Worst seed (s300003-r2) shows the doctrine has no catch-up lever: pop stuck at 11, slowest unit ramp (129 final), and the only rank-3 besides s947381-r0 — behavior identical to winning games despite the different position.
evidence: City cap honored perfectly: cities=2 at every sample in all 8 games (t=10 through t=160), never exceeding max_cities: 2.

Tech curve matches the doctrine's finite research list exactly: techs plateau at 8 in every game, reached by t=20 in 7 of 8 games (s300003-r2 by t=30), consistent with completing MINING through IRRIGATION and then stopping.

Unit buildup is the turtle signature: monotonic unit growth from ~3 at t=10 to 129-177 at t=160 with zero declines (e.g., s947381-r1: 2→177; s300003-r3: 3→175), consistent with march:false + fortify_idle massing defenders that never leave or die.
Gold cycles in 30-60g swings (e.g., s947381-r2: 139→99→59→99→139→59) consistent with periodic purchases per purchase_pref and warrior buys rather than hoarding.

Pop ramps early then plateaus at 11-16 across all games, and scalar climbs a steady ~+100-170 per 10 turns driven mainly by unit accumulation, ending 2009-2628 with mean rank 2.0 and 2 wins — the turtle scaling delivered mid-to-top finishes.

pivot_assessment.notes: Zero switches and zero doctrines_played across all 8 recorded games. This seat ran the static turtler doctrine start-to-finish every game, so there is no pivot timing or flip-flop behavior to evaluate. Given identical behavior in both the rank-1 and rank-3 games, the absence of any adaptive trigger is the main ceiling on this doctrine.

recommended_changes: Add a unit cap or garrison threshold (e.g., stop military builds near ~1 unit per pop point, or ~60-80 total for 2 cities) and redirect overflow production to GRANARY/infrastructure; the current +11 units/10t treadmill runs to t=160 with gold floors of 45-59.
Give GRANARY priority over MONUMENT in purchase_pref (currently 2nd): pop plateaus at 11-16 in every game and pop is the main non-unit scalar contributor after techs finish at t=20.
Add a research overflow rule after the 8-tech list completes (~t=20): convert science to gold/wealth or an optional tech list so 140 idle turns of research capacity aren't wasted.

Add a deficit trigger: if scalar trails the field at a mid-game checkpoint (as in s300003-r2, scalar 1099 at t=60 vs 1307-1388 in same-seed peers), allow a third city or shift to economic purchases instead of replaying identical unit spam into a rank-3.
